title:
Comment of Ashlyn Hall in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151687.txt
documents.text:
Ashlyn Hall, Greensboro, NC.
Permitting underwater data center development would cause egregious harm to this coastal ecosystem and threaten right whales. This project is neither necessary nor inevitable, and propelling it forward does more harm to countless communities than good for this corporation. Do not issue this permit.
